Requirement: Visitors can move between all pages using the header, logo and links
Every page loads correctly, with the right title and no errors
Pages show accurate company information
Visitors can contact the company by email and LinkedIn
Visitors can browse career roles using tabs and direct links
Role tabs can be used with the keyboard
The site works on small screens, with a collapsible menu
The footer shows the current year and a LinkedIn link
Public pages meet WCAG 2.1 AA and have correct page metadata
Authorised staff can sign in with valid credentials
Invalid sign-ins are rejected without revealing which detail was wrong, and repeated failures lock sign-in
Sessions end on sign-out, after 15 minutes of inactivity, and across browser tabs
Admin pages are not available to signed-out visitors
Viewers have read-only access; only editors can change services
Editors can add, edit and delete services
Service details are validated, with clear and accessible error messages
Changes appear on the public Services page and survive a reload
Saved text is always displayed safely and never run as code
Editors can reset the services to the original list
Admin pages are accessible, usable by keyboard, and fit small screens
